config.enhancedlittlemaidai.title: ELMAI
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.memory.compr: Memory count threshold to trigger LLM compression
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.memory.dedup: BM25 similarity above which memories are considered duplicates (0.5~1.0)
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.memory.compr: Number of oldest memories to compress in each batch
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.memory.targe: Maximum number of summaries generated by LLM after compression
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.memory.spati: How far (blocks) around a memory location the maid recalls related memories
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.memory.seman: How many of the most relevant memories to inject into each conversation
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.memory.maxFr: Memories stay fresh within this time window; beyond it they rely on importance score
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.proactive.en: When disabled, maids will not initiate conversations
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.proactive.co: Min interval between proactive chats, 600 = 10 min
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.proactive.tr: Probability of triggering proactive chat per tick after cooldown
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.proactive.ma: Maximum proactive chat triggers per Minecraft day (reset at sunrise)
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.proactive.mi: Owner must be within this distance for proactive chat to trigger
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.proactive.ev: Min interval between environment event-triggered chats, 300 = 5 min
Maximum environment event chat triggers per Minecraft day (reset at sunrise)
When a maid triggers an environment event, nearby maids within this range are blocked from triggering simultaneously. 16=short range, 128=entire dimension
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.proactive.pr: Character setting length: FULL(complete) SUMMARY(first 200 chars) MINIMAL(name only)
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.context.bfsD: Maximum BFS scan depth for nearby blocks (higher = larger area)
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.context.enti: Maximum range (blocks) for detecting nearby entities
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.context.maxE: Maximum number of entity details returned to the LLM
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.mining.enabl: Replace MLM hardcoded mining messages with LLM dialogue based on maid character setting
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.interMaid.en: Allow nearby maids to auto-initiate conversations
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.interMaid.pr: Character setting length: FULL(complete) SUMMARY(first 200 chars) MINIMAL(name only)
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.interMaid.ma: Max conversation rounds per session (A→B→A counts as 2-4 rounds)
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.interMaid.wo: Max distance between working maids to trigger conversation
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.interMaid.id: Max distance between idle maids to trigger conversation
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.interMaid.wo: Per-tick scan probability for working maids
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.interMaid.id: Per-tick scan probability for idle maids
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.interMaid.sc: How often maids scan for nearby companions, 40 = every 2 seconds
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.interMaid.pl: Any player must be within this range for maid conversation to trigger
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.interMaid.ma: Max Chats Per Maid Per Day
Maximum conversations per maid per Minecraft day (reset at sunrise)
Maximum total maid conversations per day (reset at sunrise)
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.interMaid.co: Cooldown between same pair of maids, 300 = 5 minutes
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.interMaid.de: How maid B decides to accept: LLM(AI judgment via social memory) WEIGHT(probability only)
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.interMaid.cr: Allow maids owned by different players to chat with each other
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.interMaid.ma: Maximum number of maids in a single conversation (2-5)
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.interMaid.ro: Minimum random wait time between social chat rounds
Maximum random wait time between social chat rounds
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.interMaid.so: Probability of injecting social memories into proactive chat
Max number of social memories injected at once
Maximum social memories stored per maid
Memory count threshold to trigger social memory compression
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.storage.enab: Auto-write MindPalace memory on maid fetch/store operations
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.storage.maxS: Max container positions to show in nearby storage context
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.storage.maxI: Max item types to show per storage position
Max item types to show in storage summary
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.debug.debugL: Enable detailed debug output to log file
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.debug.suppre: Suppress TouhouLittleMaid parent mod's LLM request/response JSON dump logs. Disable to see raw console output
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.debug.enable: Auto-generate character setting and greet upon maid placement
